El LCL se cobra por W/M, es decir, peso o medida: una tonelada o un metro cúbico, lo que sea mayor. La carga densa se cobra por peso y la carga liviana y voluminosa por volumen. La mayoría de las navieras y consolidadores también aplican un cargo mínimo.
¿Cuándo un contenedor completo resulta más barato que el LCL?

When your cargo fills enough de the box that the container price is lower than the W/M rate times your cargo. The calculator shows that break-even point in W/M and as a share de the container. It is often around half to two thirds de a 20 foot or 40 foot box, but it depends entirely on the two quotes.
¿Por qué el flete aéreo se calcula a 167 kg por metro cúbico?

Airlines charge on the higher de actual weight and volumetric weight. The IATA standard divides volume by 6000 cubic centimetres per kilogram, which equals 167 kg per cubic metre. Light, bulky cargo therefore costs much more by air than its weight suggests.
¿Por qué el resultado marítimo o aéreo incluye un costo del dinero?

Goods on a ship are stock you have paid for but cannot sell. The extra weeks at sea tie up that cash. Putting a yearly cost on it shows whether the saving on freight really beats the cost de waiting. Set it to zero to compare freight only.
